# Hydra : Full Reference

> Complete text reference for hydra.peticila.ro, Adrian M. Peticila's project shelf.

## Core Shelf Items

### 001 · Slop Detector
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/slop/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: A deterministic rules engine that scans text against 76 lexical markers and rhythm checks to identify the textural habits of machine-generated prose.
Architecture: Pure client-side JavaScript. Zero backend, zero telemetry.

### 002 · Voice Fingerprint
URL: https://aah.monster/voice-fingerprint/
Type: Paid service (€249)
What it is: A structured 48-hour concierge analysis turning 15-20 writing samples into a concrete voice operating manual, never-list, and ghostwriter brief.

### 003 · Homepage Roaster
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/roast/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: An automated inspection of public HTML that analyzes positioning clarity, unearned claims, and above-the-fold friction.

### 004 · Canon
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/canon/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: Generates structured markdown canon rules and cross-checks published copy for internal contradictions across claims and numbers.

### 005 · The Guilt Trip
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/guilt/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: Audits product copy (notifications, cancel screens, paywalls) for emotional pressure levers (confirmshaming, sad mascots, loss framing) and provides honest alternatives.

### 006 · Aah, Monster!
URL: https://aah.monster
Type: Consultancy
What it is: Adrian M. Peticila's executive personal branding consultancy.

### 007 · Right now
URL: https://peticila.ro/#now
Type: Hand-updated log
What it is: Current weekly focus and operating status.

### 008 · Deck Rubric
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/deck/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: Eleven-part pitch deck diagnostic evaluating answers, narrative sequence, and traction positioning.

### 009 · AI Demand Map
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/demand/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: Strategic taxonomy mapping high-intent queries against underserved product whitespace.

### 010 · AI Executive System
URL: https://aah.monster/ai-executive/
Type: Paid service (€1,500)
What it is: A complete written operating system and decision protocol for executive delegation and AI pair-programming workflows.

### 011 · Aeolus
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/aeolus/
Type: Free browser tool
What it is: Pre-merge branch diff auditor for AI coding agents. Catches exposed secrets, forbidden em-dashes, and dirty files before push.

### 012 · Chasm
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/chasm/
Type: Free browser tool & Python CLI
What it is: Deterministic editorial gate as code. Blocks 36 hard-kill corporate cliches, 22 soft fillers, sentence cadence variance, and fragment stacking. A draft physically passes or fails without subjective deliberation.

### 013 · Tyche
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/tyche/
Type: Free browser tool & Python CLI
What it is: B2B executive hook bank and cognitive tension scoring engine. Evaluates specificity, tension, arithmetic, and voice fit. Generates 5 operator rewrites based on proven frameworks.

### 014 · Cadmus
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/cadmus/
Type: Free browser tool & Python CLI
What it is: Content ROI audit and distribution canvas based on user behavior. Evaluates saves, bookmarks, unassisted shares, and qualified inquiries to isolate compounding assets from vanity reach.

### 015 · Athena
URL: https://hydra.peticila.ro/athena/
Type: Free browser tool & Python CLI
What it is: Deterministic OpenGraph card and brand asset generator in pure vector SVG. Encodes design tokens directly into SVG output with real-time browser preview and canvas PNG export.

## Technical Standards
- Zero dependencies for browser tools.
- Pure HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript.
- Light theme default with dark theme toggle via localStorage.
- Schema.org WebApplication markup on all tools.
- Bureau of Engraving and Printing (BEP) vintage banknote engravings restored under CC BY-SA 3.0.
- Typography: Unbounded (900), Bricolage Grotesque, DM Mono.
